# WorldNewzs - Extended Platform Architecture & Content Documentation

> Complete technical, editorial, schema, and API specifications for WorldNewzs (worldnewzs.in). Designed for AI search indexers, large language models, and automated crawler consumption.

## 1. System Overview
WorldNewzs is a modern real-time news aggregator and analytical journalism hub built on React, TypeScript, ASP.NET Core, PostgreSQL, and Google Gemini AI. The platform processes high-velocity news feeds from authoritative global sources (BBC, Reuters, AP News, Bloomberg, TechCrunch, Nature, etc.), enriches them with non-partisan synthesis, fact-checked editorial context, and categorical FAQs, and provides interactive community tools.

## 2. Content Cadence & Pillar Guidelines
- **Pillar News Categories**: Politics, Technology, Business, Science & Health. Minimum depth of 1,500–2,000 words per major topic with historical context, real-time updates, expert quotes, data points, and dedicated FAQs.
- **Standard News Categories**: Sports, Money, Lifestyle, Education, Opinion, Trending, Local News, Podcasts-Videos, Food, Travel, Entertainment, Services, Gaming, Cartoons. Target depth of 600–1,000 words.
- **AI Daily Briefings Engine**: Generates automated, deduplicated JSON briefings for today's Top News and category-by-category More News.

## 4. API Endpoints
- News Feeds: `GET https://worldnewz.onrender.com/api/news/{category}`
- Daily Briefings: `GET https://worldnewz.onrender.com/api/news/daily-briefing`
- Dynamic Sitemap: `GET https://worldnewzs.in/sitemap.xml`
- Google News Sitemap: `GET https://worldnewzs.in/news-sitemap.xml`
- Robots Configuration: `GET https://worldnewzs.in/robots.txt`
- RSS Feed: `GET https://worldnewzs.in/rss/discover`
